question: According to the Census of India 2001, how much percentage of the immigrant population was from Sri Lanka?
solution:
The correct answer is __**option 2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• According to the Census of India 2001, the percentage of the immigrant population from Sri Lanka was **2.9%**.
 
• The Census of India 2001 provides comprehensive data on immigration patterns within the country.
 
• This data includes the origins of immigrants, their reasons for migration, and their distribution across different states.
 
• Sri Lanka is one of the countries that contributed to the immigrant population in India as per the 2001 census data.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Immigration Terminology:**

 
 
• **Immigrant:** A person who comes to live permanently in a foreign country.
 
• **Migrant:** A person who moves from one place to another, especially to find work or better living conditions.
 
• **Refugee:** A person who has been forced to leave their country in order to escape war, persecution, or natural disaster.
 
 
 
• **Census of India:**
 
 
• The Census of India is conducted every 10 years by the Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner, India under the Ministry of Home Affairs.
 
• The first census in India was conducted in 1872.
 
• The latest census was conducted in 2011, with the next scheduled for 2021, but postponed due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
 
 
• **Immigration Patterns:**
 
 
• Immigration patterns can be influenced by factors such as economic opportunities, political stability, and social factors.
 
• India has seen significant immigration from neighboring countries like Bangladesh, Pakistan, and Nepal.
 
 
 
• **Indian Diaspora:**
 
 
• The Indian diaspora is one of the largest in the world, with significant populations in the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, and the Middle East.
 
• The Indian government actively engages with the diaspora through various initiatives such as the Pravasi Bharatiya Divas.
